title: fs: scoped getKeys traverses unrelated directories
body:
`getKeys("tenant-42")` reads every directory under the filesystem storage root before core filters the keys. Both `fs` and `fs-lite` ignore the base passed to `getKeys`.

With 80 tenants, 10 buckets per tenant and four keys per bucket, the pinned repro returns 40 matching keys but performs 881 directory reads. A prefix-aware walk needs 12 reads; a missing prefix needs one. The paired patch keeps the original root, root-relative `maxDepth`, normalized full keys and ancestor ignore rules.

This follows the focused fs/fs-lite optimization discussed in #546. Starting the walk directly at the base would lose those full-key and depth rules. Pruning also means unrelated subtrees no longer produce I/O errors or ignore-callback calls; visited paths must retain their error behavior.

Run with Node 24. The first directory proves the current behavior; the second proves the patch with the same verifier. Dependencies are pinned, and no external service is needed.

```sh
git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse --branch repro/unstorage-fs-prefix https://github.com/onmax/repros.git unstorage-fs-prefix-repro
cd unstorage-fs-prefix-repro
git sparse-checkout set unstorage-fs-prefix unstorage-fs-prefix-fix
cd unstorage-fs-prefix
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && corepack pnpm verify
cd ../unstorage-fs-prefix-fix
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && corepack pnpm verify
```

Model: GPT-5.6 Sol. Harness: Codex.
